decision: FINAL failed with 2 confirmed findings. One EXECUTOR fix (execute-04), then RE_REVIEW(3,1) and FINAL_REVIEW(3,2). Both entries were already edited in this window and are fixed as whole sentences.

findings.reason: Cults 公开源码（来源未固定）tome-cults/data/talents/demented/tentacles.lua:76 “You generate a low power psionic field around you when around 'civilized people' that prevents them from seeing you for the horror you are.”：该力场只用于掩饰真身，不是防护。现译“微弱的心灵护盾”把 field 译成“护盾”，在 ToME 中会被读作吸收伤害的护盾效果，机制误导；psionic 在术语库作“灵能”（combat.tsv effect subtype、talents.tsv talent category）。第379批宿主曾判此处为措辞不改，本窗口该条已改动，FINAL 指出的机制误读成立，予以确认。修复：“微弱的心灵护盾”→“微弱的灵能力场”，其余不变。

Cults 公开源码（来源未固定）tome-cults/data/zones/dremshor-tunnel/npcs.lua:18-22、62：本 killer_message 属于 The Amalgamation，一团由多具躯体融合成的血肉怪物；“and absorbed into the foul thing” 指玩家被吸进凶手自身。execute-02 按 pending #50 B 改成凶手主语后，“并将其吸收到了那个肮脏的东西体内”让“那个肮脏的东西”读作凶手以外的第三方。修复：整条 target→“并将其吸进了自己那肮脏的躯体”。
